startUrls.title: Website URLs
startUrls.description: Homepages (or any page) of the companies you want to look up. One record per domain is returned.

validateVatId.title: Validate VAT ID via EU VIES
validateVatId.description: Checks every found DE/AT VAT ID against the official EU VIES service and adds the registered name/address when the member state returns it. Swiss UIDs are not in VIES.

maxCandidatesPerSite.title: Max legal-notice pages per site
maxCandidatesPerSite.description: How many candidate pages (Impressum, Imprint, Legal notice, Kontakt) to fetch per site. Higher = more robust, slightly more usage.

tryCommonPaths.title: Try common paths when no link is found
tryCommonPaths.description: If the homepage has no recognizable Impressum link, probe /impressum, /imprint, /legal-notice, /kontakt.

useBrowserFallback.title: Browser fallback for JavaScript-rendered sites
useBrowserFallback.description: If a legal page comes back empty over plain HTTP (single-page apps, consent walls), re-fetch it with a headless browser. Costs more compute per page but rescues most large e-commerce sites.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (datacenter) is used by default so that sites blocking cloud IPs still answer. Switch to residential proxies (optionally with a country) for sites with strong bot protection or strict geo-routing.
